name: Cliniko
description: Cliniko is practice-management software for healthcare clinics and allied health practitioners. Teams use it for online bookings, schedules, patients, treatment notes, forms, communications, invoices, products, availability, and day-to-day clinic administration.
agentUseSummary: Add a dedicated Cliniko API key once, then choose which agents can use the connected user's complete current API authority under Safe or Dangerous policy.

credentialRequirements.name: CLINIKO_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Cliniko API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated key under My info → Manage API keys. Relay uses its shard suffix to select the correct regional API.

capabilities.label: Read practice and clinical data
capabilities.description: Read every current Cliniko resource available to the connected user, including appointments, patients, treatment notes, forms, availability, billing, products, practitioners, and settings.

capabilities.label: Manage practice and clinical records
capabilities.description: Use every current non-deprecated Cliniko mutation for appointments, patients, clinical records, communications, availability, products, pricing, and practice administration.

capabilities.label: Upload patient attachments
capabilities.description: Upload bounded patient files through Cliniko's provider-issued storage workflow without exposing temporary credentials.

allowed.label: Read Cliniko
allowed.description: Run any of 102 current non-deprecated read operations.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Cliniko
approvalRequired.description: Run any of 92 current non-deprecated direct mutations.

approvalRequired.label: Upload a patient attachment
approvalRequired.description: Complete Cliniko's two-operation presigned patient-attachment workflow without exposing temporary storage credentials.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: The API key and temporary attachment-upload fields never enter agent-visible requests or results.

blocked.label: Call another origin
blocked.description: Every API request uses the Cliniko shard encoded in the customer's key; attachment upload accepts only Cliniko-issued HTTPS Amazon S3 targets.

blocked.label: Call another endpoint
blocked.description: Relay permits all 196 current non-deprecated operations through 194 exact routes and one two-operation attachment workflow.

blocked.label: Run an unbounded transfer
blocked.description: Relay bounds queries, bodies, files, responses, redirects, nesting, and execution time.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: All 102 current reads run directly. Every mutation and patient-attachment upload requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected operation runs without Relay per-action approval. Cliniko user authority, regional shard binding, exact routes, bounds, credential protection, healthcare-data controls, rate limits, and audits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts all 196 current non-deprecated Cliniko operations through exact shard-bound wrappers and one bounded attachment workflow.
Railway mounts all 196 current non-deprecated Cliniko operations through exact shard-bound wrappers and one bounded attachment workflow.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer-owned Cliniko account, dedicated user API key, representative clinical data, or authorized live test account is available. An API key inherits the generating user's authority and exposes sensitive healthcare data.
providerSetup.nextAction: Have an authorized Cliniko user create a dedicated Relay Console API key under My info, connect it, then verify shard derivation, all read domains, Safe denial and approval, Dangerous mutations, bounded attachment upload, redaction, 200-per-minute handling, key rotation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Cliniko documents per-user API-key Basic authentication, required app user agent, HTTPS-only JSON, sensitive-data handling, and a 200-request-per-minute per-user rate limit.
The official current OpenAPI v1 description contains 196 non-deprecated operations: 103 GET operations and 93 mutations.
Cliniko documents regional shard suffixes in API keys and the fixed https://api.{shard}.cliniko.com/v1 authority.
Cliniko documents the three-step presigned Amazon S3 patient-attachment workflow and provider-issued temporary fields.
Cliniko instructs each user to create a dedicated integration API key and warns that the key grants access to sensitive account data.
